description: This file defines Express.js routes for authentication-related endpoints, including health check, signup, login, and password reset, with JWT token issuance and tenant-specific password hashing.

methods.name: router.get('/health')
methods.description: Health check endpoint for auth configuration status.

methods.name: router.post('/signup')
methods.description: Endpoint to create or update a user with hashed password, auto-generating tenant salt if needed.

methods.name: router.post('/login')
methods.description: Authenticate user, issue JWT token, and handle legacy hash migration.

methods.name: router.post('/reset-password')
methods.description: Reset user password with tenant-specific hashing, generating tenant salt if missing.
